thread:
elaine: Quick sync — product wants a single console view that shows cost-per-1k tokens + explicit breakdown for cache & batch savings. Need runtime + infra telemetry so the numbers are trusted. Who can own the telemetry contract?

tim: I can take the runtime side. what fields exactly do we need?

pranav: Minimal list from infra/serving perspective:
```
tokens_in
tokens_out
compute_ms
batch_size
cache_hit (bool)
route (string)
model_variant
quota_key
```
If we emit those per-request (or aggregated in the router), we can derive cost and savings later.

elaine: That looks good. ops/console needs the per-1k math and labels for rollouts (canary vs default). Also want P50/P95 latency buckets tied to batching size.

ops-ux: For UX, we need these aggregates: 
- cost_per_1k (computed)
- cache_savings_pct and cache_savings_tokens
- batching_savings_pct and batching_savings_tokens
- avg_batch_size histogram
- latency_by_batch_size (p50/p95)
Also want to toggle by routing policy and by model_variant in the UI.

pranav: Note: cache_hit alone isn't enough to compute savings. We should also emit `baseline_tokens_compute_ms` when cache missed vs hit so analytics can subtract. Or emit `tokens_saved` when cache hit. Which do you prefer?

tim: I'd rather emit `tokens_saved` on hit (int) and `compute_ms` always. Simpler downstream. Runtime can sum tokens_saved to show direct delta.

pranav: ok `tokens_saved` it is. Also: batch-level vs request-level telemetry debate — continuous batching groups many requests, so we should emit a `batch_id` and `batch_aggregate` event every time a batch is flushed with fields: `{batch_id,batch_size,total_tokens_in,total_tokens_out,compute_ms,route}`. That keeps per-request cheaper and still lets us compute per-request attribution offline.

elaine: Good call. So final telemetry list for the initial roll: per-request minimal + batch_aggregate on flush. Can we add `route_policy` (why request went to a path) for routing cost splits? e.g., `route_policy: "latency_fallback"`

pranav: yes, `route_policy` can be routed by the router and stamped.

ops-ux: Timeline? product needs a mock in the console by next Wednesday. We can use sampled telemetry for the mock but we need the names/fields locked.

tim: I'll add request emit + batch flush event in runtime by Tue EOD. Will add sampling flag `telemetry_sample_rate` default 1% for hosted to avoid high costs during rollout.

elaine: Who owns the aggregation job for cost_per_1k? infra-team or analytics? We need that to be the source of truth for billing-ish dashboards.

pranav: Infra can provide a streaming job that writes daily aggregates to metrics-store; analytics can take that and run UI slicing. I'd prefer infra owns the canonical per-route/per-model aggregates.

ops-ux: That division works. UX will point to infra-aggregates for the main numbers and fallback to a computed view from analytics for interactive ad-hoc slices.

elaine: Decision notes:
- Telemetry shape locked: per-request (tokens_in,tokens_out,compute_ms,tokens_saved,batch_id,cache_hit,route,route_policy,model_variant,quota_key) + batch_flush aggregate.
- Runtime to implement sampling + batch_flush events (tim).
- Infra to provide daily streaming aggregate job for cost_per_1k by route/model/quota_key (pranav).
- Ops/UX to mock console widgets with sampled data for product by Wed (sophie).

sophie: Will spin up a mock dashboard prototype using fake data that matches the schema. ETA Weds EOD.

tim: quick note on cost calc: we should publish the formula in docs so product and finance agree: example formula for cost_per_1k: 
```
gpu_cost_per_ms * compute_ms_total / (tokens_total/1000) + infra_share_per_request
```
We can refine with memory & network later.

elaine: Ty. please add the formula to the telemetry PR so infra aggregates compute the same way.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: telemetry-schema-v1 -> staging at 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC :rocket:

elaine: Follow-ups:
- tim: PR for runtime telemetry schema + sampling flag (assign to tim)
- pr anav: streaming aggregate job spec + retention (assign to pr anav)
- sophie: console mock + sample data set (assign to sophie)
- ops-ux: final widget spec (assign to ops-ux)
I'll collect these and put into the weekly handoff doc. :thumbsup:

pranav: one more: quota interactions — if a request is rerouted due to quota breach, we need `original_quota_key` and `final_quota_key` so cost attribution is correct.

elaine: add that field. good catch.

sophie: ok adding `original_quota_key` + `final_quota_key` to the mock.

elaine: Great sync. Thanks all — I'll update the handoff doc and post a follow-up in #product once mock is up.

ops-ux: feel free to ping me for runbook on widget states during canary.

pranav: will open infra spec PR later today.

tim: starting runtime PR now.

elaine: closing thread, will follow up if anything blocks.
